snippet.title: Untold Stories 9: Castlemania Minecraft CTM map trailer
snippet.description:
Assault dangerous castles with arcane wands. 
Explore grand landscapes with mystery around every corner.
Uncover the secrets that haunt the forlorn towers.

Untold Stories returns with a ninth instalment. Castlemania is a 16-objective Minecraft map for Minecraft 1.19.3. This open-world map is not for the faint of heart, as it is up to par with my most difficult maps.
 
You can download the map from the CTM Repository:
https://ctmrepository.com/index.php?action=viewMap&id=469
